```{r setup, include=F}
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(pheatmap)
library(eulerr)
library(tidyverse)
library(deming)
source("scripts/helpers.R")

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 5,
  fig.height = 7,
  fig.show = "hold",
  out.width = "50%"
)
```

```{r read data, include=F}
source("scripts/main-data.R")
source("scripts/compare-genelists-function.R")
```

```{r themes}

# a consistent color scale

goi_up = dea %>%
  filter(
    FDR <= 0.05,
    log2fold >= 1
  ) %>%
  pull(Gene) %>%
  unique()

up_mat = mat[goi_up, ]

myColors = generic_l2f_heatmap_colors(
  up_mat,
  scaleType = "symmetric",
  clipFactor = 0.995
)

# column splits 

myColsplits = factor(
  c(
    rep("WT", 4),
    rep("sham", 4),
    rep("TAK1KO", 4),
    rep("KO + lipid", 4),
    rep("rescue", 4),
    rep("mutant rescue", 4)
  ),
  levels = c(
    "WT",
    "sham",
    "TAK1KO",
    "KO + lipid",
    "rescue",
    "mutant rescue"
  )
)

# a prism-like ggplot2 theme

theme_prismLike = theme_bw() +
    theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(-0.15, "cm"),
    axis.ticks.y.right = element_line(),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.6)
  )

cleanup_objects()
```


738 DEGs upregulated by IL-1β (≥2-fold, P ≤ 0.05) 

Check everything in relation to wt_738

```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=4}
wt_up_738 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "WT", sig == "up") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

sham_up_751 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "sham", sig == "up") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

ko_up_71 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "TAK1KO", rescue == "naive", sig == "up") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

lipid_up_68 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "TAK1KO", rescue == "lipid", sig == "up") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

rescue_up_540 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "TAK1KO", rescue == "TAK1-smRNA", sig == "up") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

mutant_up_139 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "TAK1KO", rescue == "mTAK1-smRNA", sig == "up") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

for (name in c(
  "sham_up_751",
  "ko_up_71",
  "lipid_up_68",
  "rescue_up_540",
  "mutant_up_139"
)) {
  
  plot_gene_sets(
    list(
      wt_up_738 = wt_up_738,
      set = get(name)
    ) %>% setNames(c("wt_up_738", name)),
    show_heatmap = F
  )
}

# write gene lists and sleuth results

group_lists = list()

for (name in c(
  "wt_up_738",
  "sham_up_751",
  "ko_up_71",
  "lipid_up_68",
  "rescue_up_540",
  "mutant_up_139"
)) {
  
  l = get(name)
  
  g = case_when(
    name == "wt_up_738" ~ "WT_naive",
    name == "sham_up_751" ~ "sham_naive",
    name == "ko_up_71" ~ "TAK1KO_naive",
    name == "lipid_up_68" ~ "TAK1KO_lipid",
    name == "rescue_up_540" ~ "TAK1KO_TAK1-smRNA",
    name == "mutant_up_139" ~ "TAK1KO_mTAK1-smRNA"
  )
  
  df = dea %>%
    filter(Gene %in% l, group == g)
  
  group_lists[[name]] = df
}

writexl::write_xlsx(group_lists, "data/venn-group-genelists.xlsx")



cleanup_objects()

```





Q1a: RE sham - How many DEGs are induced (≥2-fold, P ≤ 0.05) in the sham? How many are significantly different (≥2/≤0.5 -fold, P ≤ 0.05) from wt?

```{r, fig.height=2, fig.width=3, dpi=600}
# ===== with log2fold and p value criteria =====

wt_up_738 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "WT", sig == "up") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

sham_up_751 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "sham", sig == "up") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

genelists = list(
  wt_up_738 = wt_up_738,
  sham_up_751 = sham_up_751
)

plot_gene_sets(
  genelists,
  mat,
  # mat_cols = 1:8,
  colorScale = myColors,
  heatmapColsplits = myColsplits,
  plotType = "euler"
)

# ===== plot total correlations =====

df = tpm %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = unique(group))) %>%
  filter(
    # Gene %in% unique(c(wt_up_738, sham_up_751)),
    # Gene %in% intersect(wt_up_738, sham_up_751),
    Gene %in% wt_up_738,
    group %in% c("WT_naive", "sham_naive"),
    treatment == "IL1B"
  ) %>%
  select(Gene, group, log2fold) %>%
  group_by(Gene, group) %>%
  summarize(log2fold = mean(log2fold), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "group", values_from = "log2fold")

pearson = cor.test(df[,2][[1]], df[,3][[1]], method = "pearson")$estimate[[1]]

deming = deming(sham_naive~WT_naive, df)
deming_intercept = deming$coefficients[[1]]
deming_slope = deming$coefficients[[2]]

info = paste0(
  "Pearson=", round(pearson, 2), 
  "; slope=", round(deming_slope, 2),
  "; intercept=", round(deming_intercept, 2)
  )


ggplot(df, aes(x = WT_naive, y = sham_naive)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, fill = "white") +
  geom_abline(slope = deming_slope, intercept = deming_intercept, color = "blue") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_prismLike +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-2, 12)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-2, 12)) +
  labs(caption = info)

cleanup_objects()
```

Q1a.1: effect of just going with the P-value (i.e., drop fold criteria?) Does it collapse into a single group.

```{r}
# ===== use log2fold + pvalue to select, but then drop log2fold =====

# establish 844 gene pool

wt_up_738 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "WT", sig == "up") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

sham_up_751 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "sham", sig == "up") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

union_844 = unique(c(wt_up_738, sham_up_751))

# pull pool genes, then drop to pvalue criteria only only

wt_up_l2f_dropped = dea %>%
  filter(condition == "WT", Gene %in% union_844) %>%
  filter(FDR <= 0.05, log2fold > 0) %>%
  pull(Gene)

sham_up_l2f_dropped = dea %>%
  filter(condition == "sham", Gene %in% union_844) %>%
  filter(FDR <= 0.05, log2fold > 0) %>%
  pull(Gene)

genelists = list(
  wt_up_l2f_dropped = wt_up_l2f_dropped,
  sham_up_l2f_dropped = sham_up_l2f_dropped
)

plot_gene_sets(
  genelists,
  mat,
  mat_cols = 1:8,
  colorScale = myColors
)

# ===== calculate correlations ======

for(c in c("01", "11", "10")){
  
  goi = plot_gene_sets(
    genelists,
    mat,
    output = "codes"
  ) %>%
    filter(code == c) %>%
    pull(Gene)
  
  df = dea %>%
    filter(group %in% c("WT_naive", "sham_naive"), Gene %in% goi) %>%
    select(Gene, group, log2fold) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = "group", values_from = "log2fold")
  
  cor = cor.test(df$WT_naive, df$sham_naive, method = "pearson")$estimate[[1]]
  
  print(paste0("code:", c, " pearson= ", cor, " (", length(goi), " genes)"))
  
  rm(c, goi, df, cor)
  
}

cleanup_objects()

```


Q1b: In how many genes is the IL1B response affected by sham (P<= 0.05)?

```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=4}
sham_il1b_interaction = read_tsv("data/sham_IL1B_interaction_test.txt")

wt_up_738 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "WT", sig == "up") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

# sham_up_751 = dea %>% 
#   filter(condition == "sham", sig == "up") %>% 
#   pull(Gene)
# 
# union_844 = unique(c(wt_up_738, sham_up_751))

df = as.data.frame(wt_up_738, nm = "Gene") %>%
  left_join(
    sham_il1b_interaction %>% 
      select(Gene, log2diff, FDR)
    )

hist(df$log2diff, breaks = 100)
summary(df$log2diff)

hist(df$FDR, breaks = 100)
summary(df$FDR)

df %>%
  mutate(
    direction = case_when(
      log2diff == 0  ~ "0 or NA log2diff",
      log2diff <= 0 ~ "-ve log2diff",
      log2diff >= 0  ~ "+ve log2diff"
    )
  ) %>%
  count(direction) %>%
  mutate(percent = 100*n/sum(n))

df %>%
  mutate(sig = if_else(FDR <= 0.05, "FDR<=0.05", "ns")) %>%
  count(sig) %>%
  mutate(percent = 100*n/sum(n))

cleanup_objects()
```

Q2a.1: effect of just going with the P-value (i.e., drop fold criteria?) Does it collapse into a single group.

```{r}
# ===== use log2fold + pvalue to select, but then drop log2fold =====

# establish 741 gene pool

wt_up_738 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "WT", sig == "up") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

ko_up_71 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "TAK1KO", rescue == "naive", sig == "up") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

union_741 = unique(c(wt_up_738, ko_up_71))

# pull pool genes, then drop to pvalue criteria only only

wt_up_l2f_dropped = dea %>%
  filter(condition == "WT", Gene %in% union_741) %>%
  filter(FDR <= 0.05, log2fold > 0) %>%
  pull(Gene)

ko_up_l2f_dropped = dea %>%
  filter(group == "TAK1KO_naive", Gene %in% union_741) %>%
  filter(FDR <= 0.05, log2fold > 0) %>%
  pull(Gene)

genelists = list(
  wt_up_l2f_dropped = wt_up_l2f_dropped,
  ko_up_l2f_dropped = ko_up_l2f_dropped
)

plot_gene_sets(
  genelists,
  mat,
  mat_cols = c(1:4, 9:12)
)

# ===== calculate correlations ======

for(c in c("01", "11", "10")){
  
  goi = plot_gene_sets(
    genelists,
    mat,
    output = "codes"
  ) %>%
    filter(code == c) %>%
    pull(Gene)
  
  df = dea %>%
    filter(group %in% c("WT_naive", "sham_naive"), Gene %in% goi) %>%
    select(Gene, group, log2fold) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = "group", values_from = "log2fold")
  
  cor = cor.test(df$WT_naive, df$sham_naive, method = "pearson")$estimate[[1]]
  
  print(paste0("code:", c, " pearson= ", cor, " (", length(goi), " genes)"))
  
  rm(c, goi, df, cor)
  
}

cleanup_objects()

```

Q2b: In how many genes is the IL1B response affected by TAK1KO (P<= 0.05)?

```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=5}
tak1ko_il1b_interaction = read_tsv("data/KO_IL1B_interaction_test.txt")

wt_up_738 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "WT", sig == "up") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

# ko_up_71 = dea %>% 
#   filter(condition == "TAK1KO", rescue == "naive", sig == "up") %>% 
#   pull(Gene)

# union_741 = unique(c(wt_up_738, ko_up_71))

df = as.data.frame(wt_up_738, nm = "Gene") %>%
  left_join(
    tak1ko_il1b_interaction %>% 
      select(Gene, log2diff, FDR)
    )

hist(df$log2diff, breaks = 100)
summary(df$log2diff)


hist(df$FDR, breaks = 100)
summary(df$FDR)

df %>%
  mutate(
    direction = case_when(
      log2diff == 0  ~ "0 or NA log2diff",
      log2diff <= 0 ~ "-ve log2diff",
      log2diff >= 0  ~ "+ve log2diff"
    )
  ) %>%
  count(direction) %>%
  mutate(percent = 100*n/sum(n))

df %>%
  mutate(sig = if_else(FDR <= 0.05, "FDR<=0.05", "ns")) %>%
  count(sig) %>%
  mutate(percent = 100*n/sum(n))

# ===== check stats for 31% genes that were not significantly changed =====

ns_genes_stats = df %>% filter(FDR > 0.05)

ns_genes_stats %>%
  mutate(
    direction = case_when(
      log2diff == 0  ~ "0 or NA log2diff",
      log2diff <= 0 ~ "-ve log2diff",
      log2diff >= 0  ~ "+ve log2diff"
    )
  ) %>%
  count(direction) %>%
  mutate(percent = 100*n/sum(n))

hist(ns_genes_stats$log2diff, breaks = 50)
summary(ns_genes_stats$log2diff)

Heatmap(
  mat[ns_genes_stats$Gene, c(1:4, 9:12)],
  col = generic_l2f_heatmap_colors(mat[ns_genes_stats$Gene, c(1:4, 9:12)])
)

# ===== check stats for 68 genes that remain upreg in KO =======

wt_up_738 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "WT", sig == "up") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

ko_up_71 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "TAK1KO", rescue == "naive", sig == "up") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

unaffected_68 = intersect(wt_up_738, ko_up_71)

unaffected_68_stats = df %>% filter(Gene %in% unaffected_68)

hist(unaffected_68_stats$log2diff, breaks = 10)
summary(unaffected_68_stats$log2diff)

unaffected_68_stats %>%
  mutate(
    direction = case_when(
      log2diff == 0  ~ "0 or NA log2diff",
      log2diff <= 0 ~ "-ve log2diff",
      log2diff >= 0  ~ "+ve log2diff"
    )
  ) %>%
  count(direction) %>%
  mutate(percent = 100*n/sum(n))

hist(unaffected_68_stats$FDR, breaks = 10)
summary(unaffected_68_stats$FDR)

unaffected_68_stats %>%
  mutate(sig = if_else(FDR <= 0.05, "FDR<=0.05", "ns")) %>%
  count(sig) %>%
  mutate(percent = 100*n/sum(n))

# cleanup_objects()
```

Q3a: RE KO+lipid – Does the lipid change anything? So: How many DEGs are also induced (≥2-fold, P ≤ 0.05) in the KO+lipid? How many are significantly different (≥2/≤0.5 -fold, P ≤ 0.05) from KO? Ideally there are similar numbers to the KO and that very few DEGs change.

```{r}
ko_up_71 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "TAK1KO", rescue == "naive", sig == "up") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

lipid_up_68 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "TAK1KO", rescue == "lipid", sig == "up") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

genelists = list(
  ko_up_71 = ko_up_71,
  lipid_up_68 = lipid_up_68
)

plot_gene_sets(
  genelists,
  mat,
  mat_cols = c(9:16)
)

# ===== calculate correlations ======

for(c in c("01", "11", "10")){
  
  goi = plot_gene_sets(
    genelists,
    mat,
    output = "codes"
  ) %>%
    filter(code == c) %>%
    pull(Gene)
  
  df = dea %>%
    filter(group %in% c("TAK1KO_naive", "TAK1KO_lipid"), Gene %in% goi) %>%
    select(Gene, group, log2fold) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = "group", values_from = "log2fold")
  
  cor = cor.test(df$TAK1KO_naive, df$TAK1KO_lipid, method = "pearson")$estimate[[1]]
  
  print(paste0("code:", c, " pearson= ", cor, " (", length(goi), " genes)"))
  
  rm(c, goi, df, cor)
  
}

cleanup_objects()
```

```{r, fig.height=2, fig.width=3, dpi=600}

rescue_up_540 = dea %>%

genelists = list(
  # ko_up_71 = ko_up_71,

  genelists,

cleanup_objects()
```

```{r}
# establish gene pool

))

    ) %>%
  pull(Gene)

    FDR <= 0.05,
    Gene %in% union_857
    ) %>%
  pull(Gene)

rescue_up_l2f_dropped = dea %>%

  ) %>%
```
